doc.title: Houston Person Part 2 interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 2, 1998 [interview 2 of 2]

title: Goodbyes
summary: They thank each other, Person praises academia and young people, and they joke about a cruise ticket.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well it’s been a pleasure again talking with you.
Well the same here. It’s always a pleasure being here in academia, the halls of academia. I’m really having a ball. I really enjoy it up here though.
And see our young people develop, and they’re in good hands.
Right. Appreciate that, and I’ll see you tomorrow night.
Okay. Get me a ticket on the Norway if you would.
That’s on camera. Okay, see you soon.
Hey, thank you, thank you. © Fillius Jazz Archive -13-
